Speaker: Rtn. Dr. Rohan Bartake

Venue: Gundecha Education Academy, Thakur Village, Kandivali East

Date: Thursday, 13th August 2026
Time: 8:00 AM – 9:00 AM

Audience: Students of Grades X to XII of Gundecha School
De-Addiction Awareness Session

The Rotary Club of Lokhandwala Kandivali conducted an enlightening awareness session on De-Addiction – “Igniting Young Minds for a Tobacco-Free Future” at Gundecha High School, Thakur Village, Kandivali East, on 13th August 2026.

The session was led by our very own Resource Person, Rtn. Dr. Rohan Bartake, a proud member of the Rotary Club of Lokhandwala Kandivali. He shared valuable insights on the harmful effects of tobacco and the importance of making informed and healthy choices, inspiring young minds to embrace a tobacco-free future.

Around 150 students and teachers benefited from this meaningful and impactful session.
